name: VMScape
impact: Breaks virtualization host-guest isolation via branch predictor on AMD Zen CPUs and older Intel CPUs (hypervisor/KVM attack)
mitigation: Hypervisor-level isolation hardening; CPU microcode updates
boundary_statement: VMScape (CVE-2025-40300) breaks virtualization host-guest isolation on AMD Zen and older Intel CPUs via branch predictor (vBTI), demonstrated against QEMU/KVM. It is a hypervisor isolation attack, not specific to Intel TDX or AMD SEV-SNP confidential VMs.

INTENT.evidence: ETH page: VMScape breaks host-guest isolation 'on AMD Zen CPUs and older Intel CPUs' targeting QEMU/KVM. Hypervisor-isolation attack, not demonstrated on Intel TDX or AMD SEV-SNP CVMs.
